title: AI Overview Capture Registry EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v6.0 — 87 captures
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
The AI Overview Capture Registry v7.2 is an annotated corpus of 131 Google AI Overview, AI Mode, knowledge-panel, and search results responding to queries about Crimson Hexagonal Archive entities. The body supersedes the registry title’s older “v6.0 — 87 captures” surface and is organized into 79 framework captures, 26 heteronym captures, 16 site-and-surface captures, and 10 book-and-project captures.

Each entry records a query label, capture date, surface, broad- or exact-match status, image count, a transcription or summary of the generated result, source and organic-result observations, and interpretive notes about provenance, disambiguation, field formation, conventionalization, collision, or error. Broad match is treated as stronger evidence because the entity surfaces without quotation forcing.

The registry contains both successful and failed cases. Some outputs name Lee Sharks, a heteronym, a DOI, an institution, or a framework accurately. Others preserve a concept while dropping the author, attach false conventional scaffolding to distributed journals, coin acronyms not present in the archive, merge an entity with a denser neighbor, show image bleed, preserve stale pre-erratum claims, or return generic content. One entry introduces “compositional bystanding”: the archive ranks first organically while contributing nothing to the generated composition, although page layout visually fuses the two basins.

The dataset is valuable precisely because it is not only a success gallery. It records stale archive counts, incorrect co-authorship, Swiss-institute entity bleed, “fictional” hedges, conventionalized institutions, suffix loss, generic dissolution, visual mismatches, and unstable citation cards alongside strong retrieval. The final capture of *The Water Giraffe Cycle* even includes a zoological hedge after correctly identifying the literary project.

This is a capture and annotation dataset, not direct access to Google’s internal entity graph, training data, or source-selection mechanism. Interpretations such as “canon formation,” “basin victory,” “institution entered the entity graph,” or “composition layer coined” are analytic labels inferred from public outputs. Reproducibility requires the underlying screenshots, full verbatim text, timestamps, locale, account state, device, interface version, and source cards.

The record’s version history is a critical metadata issue. A v7.2 body containing 131 captures cannot remain titled v6.0 with 87 captures. Earlier counts and editions should be preserved as versions, not overwritten or blended.

**AI Overview Capture Registry** is an annotated dataset maintained by Lee Sharks that records generated-search responses to Crimson Hexagonal Archive queries.

Version 7.2 contains 131 captures divided among frameworks, heteronyms, sites and institutions, and books or projects. Entries record query form, surface, date, result content, visible sources, organic results, and provenance or disambiguation observations.

The registry documents accurate retrieval, author erasure, entity collision, false institutional scaffolding, stale claims, image mismatch, generic dissolution, and other composition patterns.

It is a public-output observational corpus, not evidence of Google’s internal model architecture. Independent use requires the screenshots and complete capture conditions.
